statement: The actual mixed-multiplier four-cusp involution of D29 commutes with no positive single-transposition involution, including a geometric deck moving its separator. The exact extension Nbad amalg Zhat(a), marked by a and p=a^-1 l, admits neither of the required separate power automorphisms. Continuous homomorphism counts into PSL2(F11) distinguish the required class pairs: 10200 versus 4920, independently verified in matrix and permutation models.
